assumption_tested: is PPL's silent window-drop a PPL quirk or cross-backend?

correlation_coverage.temporal_sql: SELECT actor_user, GROUP_CONCAT(sigma_rule_id ORDER BY timestamp) AS rule_sequence, COUNT(DISTINCT sigma_rule_id) AS rule_count, MIN(timestamp) AS first_event, MAX(timestamp) AS last_event FROM (SELECT *, 'a' AS sigma_rule_id FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE' UNION ALL SELECT *, 'b' AS sigma_rule_id FROM logs WHERE outcome='SUCCESS') AS subquery GROUP BY actor_user HAVING rule_count >= 2 AND (julianday(last_event) - julianday(first_event)) * 86400 <= 600
correlation_coverage.value_count_sql: SELECT src_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user) AS value_count FROM (SELECT * FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE') AS subquery GROUP BY src_ip HAVING value_count >= 10

event_count.correct_windowed_sql: SELECT actor_user FROM (SELECT actor_user, COUNT(*) c FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE' GROUP BY actor_user, CAST(timestamp/600 AS INT) HAVING c >= 10) GROUP BY actor_user
event_count.emitted_windowless_sql: SELECT actor_user, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM (SELECT * FROM logs WHERE outcome='FAILURE') AS subquery GROUP BY actor_user HAVING event_count >= 10

evidence_tier: B (single host; synthetic planted corpus; SQLite + pySigma-backend-sqlite 1.1.3)
